title: Reimbursement Rates and Eligibility Guidelines
before:
Income Guidelines for Free and Reduced Price Meals

SY2027 Reimbursement Rates & Income Guidelines

Chart of Accounts

For more information about Chart of Accounts and Department of Education, contact Denise Towers.

Indirect Costs

Maine currently does not have a delegation agreement in place with the US Department of Education which allows school districts to charge the National School Lunch Program or any other federal program indirect costs. Indirect cost rates must be approved by the Department of Education and no such costs have been approved or a method in place to do so. Therefore no food service program should be charged indirect costs. If so, that must be ended and the indirect costs charged to the program must be reversed.

decisions.label: Let very uneven cards find their own height
decisions.why: 1 row pairs a short card with one holding nearly three times as much. Equal heights stretch the short one and the difference reads as a hole, so these are allowed to sit at the height of what is in them.

decisions.label: Give the cards the width their content needs
decisions.why: 1 row holds two cards of very different weight in equal halves, and cards in a row are the same height — so the short one is stretched and the difference shows as empty space. 4.6× — 525 characters beside 114. Only the column widths change.

decisions.label: Make a loose address look like an address
decisions.why: 1 email address sits in the body of this page rather than in a contact block, drawn exactly like every other link — so the one that opens a mail window looks the same as the ones that go to web pages. The chip carries the same envelope the banner's contact link uses. The address itself does not change.
